global_flags.name: config
global_flags.description: Redpanda or rpk config file; default search paths are "~/.config/rpk/rpk.yaml", $PWD/redpanda.yaml, and /etc/redpanda/redpanda.yaml

global_flags.name: config-opt
global_flags.description: Override rpk configuration settings; '-X help' for detail or '-X list' for terser detail

global_flags.name: ignore-profile
global_flags.description: Ignore rpk.yaml and redpanda.yaml; use default settings

flags.name: description
flags.description: human-readable description of the credential

flags.name: ttl
flags.description: lifetime before the credential expires (for example, 720h). Omit it or pass 0 to use the default lifetime. Credentials always expire.

flags.name: activity
flags.description: activity: create, read, update, delete

flags.name: actor
flags.description: effective user email (the human on a delegated call)

flags.name: actor-type
flags.description: actor kind: user, agent, service-account

flags.name: agent
flags.description: agent name; a bare name also matches agents/<name>, a value with a '/' is sent verbatim

flags.name: agent-uid
flags.description: agent uid; stays the same across renames

flags.name: correlation-id
flags.description: one call's member events, one row per resource, denials first; any age unless --since is set

flags.name: denied
flags.description: only calls with a refusal in them (outcome denied or partial)

flags.name: event-class
flags.description: event class: api-activity, entity-management (config changes)

flags.name: fields
flags.description: fields to return, also the table columns (comma-separated), or "all"

flags.name: group
flags.description: group name of the effective user; at most 4 values per request (server limit)

flags.name: invoked-by
flags.description: authenticated caller on a delegated call, e.g. a service-account email

flags.name: limit
flags.description: maximum entries to print; 0 returns everything. A cut-off is reported on stderr and the exit code stays 0

flags.name: operation
flags.description: operation: CreateLLMProvider, tools/call, chat/completions, ...

flags.name: order-by
flags.description: sort field with an optional " desc", e.g. actor, "outcome desc"

flags.name: outcome
flags.description: call verdict: allowed, denied, partial, masked (repeatable, comma-separated)

flags.name: page-token
flags.description: resume a previous listing from the token it wrote to stderr

flags.name: parent-id
flags.description: owner id of a child resource, e.g. the MCP server name for a tool call

flags.name: parent-type
flags.description: owner type of a child resource, e.g. mcp-server for a tool call

flags.name: policy
flags.description: any policy the decision was attributed to; a bare name also matches policies/<name> and guardrails/<name>, a value with a '/' is sent verbatim

flags.name: query
flags.description: case-insensitive substring of the entry message

flags.name: resource-id
flags.description: resource id

flags.name: resource-name
flags.description: resource display name

flags.name: resource-type
flags.description: resource type as a CLI noun: mcp-server, llm-provider, agent, ... (a value with a '.' is sent verbatim)

flags.name: service
flags.description: service: LLMProviderService, MCPGateway, LLMProxy, ...

flags.name: since
flags.description: start of the window: RFC 3339, a duration ago (15m, 24h, 7d, 2w), or "all"; no lower bound with --correlation-id

flags.name: source-ip
flags.description: caller IP

flags.name: source-service
flags.description: emitting service: aigw, adp-api

flags.name: status
flags.description: operation status: succeeded, failed (the verdict is --outcome)

flags.name: subsystem
flags.description: product surface: llm-proxy, mcp-gateway, a2a-proxy, agents, guardrails, ...

flags.name: until
flags.description: end of the window, exclusive and after --since: RFC 3339 or a duration ago

flags.name: no-pager
flags.description: write directly to the terminal without a pager

flags.name: non-interactive
flags.description: print plain Markdown without a picker or pager

flags.name: refresh
flags.description: require fresh documentation; do not fall back to cached content

flags.name: url
flags.description: print URLs without opening them (page URLs need no network)

flags.name: web
flags.description: open the page in your browser instead of reading it

flags.name: limit
flags.description: maximum search results (1-100)

flags.name: display-name
flags.description: Human-readable name for display in the UI.

flags.name: provider-models
flags.description: Model identifiers available through this provider. Leave empty to allow all models. (repeatable; name (bare values comma-split) or protojson object; replaces the full list on update)

flags.name: enabled
flags.description: Whether this provider is active and accepting requests. (true when set; pass --enabled=false to disable)

flags.name: openai-config.base-url
flags.description: Override the default API endpoint. Leave empty for the standard OpenAI API. For Codex subscription passthrough, use https://chatgpt.com/backend-api/codex.

flags.name: openai-config.api-key-ref
flags.description: Secret store reference for the API key. Required unless you use authorization passthrough. Don't set both.

flags.name: openai-config.authorization-passthrough
flags.description: Forward the client's Authorization and ChatGPT-Account-ID headers instead of using a server-side API key. For Codex subscriptions, set the base URL to https://chatgpt.com/backend-api/codex. (true when set; pass --openai-config.authorization-passthrough=false to disable)

flags.name: anthropic-config.base-url
flags.description: Override the default API endpoint. Leave empty for the standard Anthropic API.

flags.name: anthropic-config.api-key-ref
flags.description: Secret store reference for the API key. Leave empty when using authorization passthrough.

flags.name: anthropic-config.authorization-passthrough
flags.description: Forward the client's Authorization header to Anthropic instead of using a server-side API key. Used for enterprise/Max plan OAuth passthrough. (true when set; pass --anthropic-config.authorization-passthrough=false to disable)

flags.name: google-config.base-url
flags.description: Override the default API endpoint. Leave empty for the standard Google Gemini API endpoint.

flags.name: google-config.api-key-ref
flags.description: Secret store reference for the Google Gemini API key.

flags.name: bedrock-config.region
flags.description: AWS region where the Bedrock endpoint is deployed. (required in its group) (alias: --region)

flags.name: bedrock-config.base-url
flags.description: Override the default Bedrock endpoint URL with an AWS Bedrock runtime host, such as a FIPS or VPC endpoint. Leave empty for the standard regional endpoint.

flags.name: bedrock-config.static-credentials.access-key-id-ref
flags.description: Secret store reference for the AWS access key ID. (required in its group) (alias: --access-key-id-ref)

flags.name: bedrock-config.static-credentials.secret-access-key-ref
flags.description: Secret store reference for the AWS secret access key. (required in its group) (alias: --secret-access-key-ref)

flags.name: bedrock-config.assume-role.role-arn
flags.description: ARN of the IAM role to assume for Bedrock access. (required in its group) (alias: --role-arn)

flags.name: bedrock-config.assume-role.external-id
flags.description: External ID for cross-account role assumption. Required when the role's trust policy mandates it.

flags.name: bedrock-config.assume-role.session-name
flags.description: Session name for CloudTrail audit logging.

flags.name: bedrock-config.api-key.api-key-ref
flags.description: Secret holding a Bedrock API key. Paste the key only, without the Bearer prefix. Rotate the secret before the key expires; the gateway does not generate or renew keys. (required in its group)

flags.name: openai-compatible-config.base-url
flags.description: Override the default API endpoint. Leave empty for the standard OpenAI API. For Codex subscription passthrough, use https://chatgpt.com/backend-api/codex.

flags.name: openai-compatible-config.api-key-ref
flags.description: Secret store reference for the API key. Leave empty for authorization passthrough or no-auth endpoints (Ollama, vLLM, local models).

flags.name: openai-compatible-config.authorization-passthrough
flags.description: Forward the client's Authorization and ChatGPT-Account-ID headers instead of using a server-side API key. For Codex subscriptions, set the base URL to https://chatgpt.com/backend-api/codex. (true when set; pass --openai-compatible-config.authorization-passthrough=false to disable)

flags.name: vertex-config.project
flags.description: Google Cloud project ID that hosts the Vertex AI models and is billed for them. (required in its group)

flags.name: vertex-config.location
flags.description: Vertex AI location: global, a multi-region (us, eu) or a region (for example, us-east5). Every model on this provider is served from this location. (required in its group)

flags.name: vertex-config.base-url
flags.description: Override the Vertex AI endpoint URL. Leave empty for the endpoint derived from the location.

flags.name: vertex-config.credentials-json.credentials-json-ref
flags.description: Secret store reference for the Google service-account key JSON document. (required in its group)

flags.name: transcripts.record-input-messages
flags.description: Capture full request bodies (prompts) on observability traces. (true when set; pass --transcripts.record-input-messages=false to disable)

flags.name: transcripts.record-output-messages
flags.description: Capture full response bodies (completions) on observability traces. (true when set; pass --transcripts.record-output-messages=false to disable)

flags.name: guardrail
flags.description: Name of a Guardrail to attach to this provider. Leave empty for no guardrail. For Bedrock provider the guardrail uses AWS Bedrock Guardrail directly. For all other providers the proxy evaluates user input against the Bedrock Guardrail's standalone backend. In both cases a guardrail intervention short-circuits the request.

flags.name: tags

flags.description: print the request that would be sent (with the computed update mask) and exit without calling the server

flags.name: pricing
flags.description: per-model pricing override in USD per million tokens (repeatable). Keys: model (required), input, output, cached, cache_write_5m, cache_write_1h; e.g. model=gpt-4o,input=2.50,output=10.00,cached=1.25. Omitted rates keep the catalog default; 0 means an explicit free rate. Merges into --provider-models by model name; on update it replaces the whole model list.

flags.description: The subsystem to match ACLs for (kafka, registry, or both)

flags.name: topic
flags.description: Topic to match ACLs for (repeatable)

flags.name: transactional-id
flags.description: Transactional IDs to match ACLs for (repeatable)

flags.name: force
flags.description: Skip the confirmation prompt. On self-managed clusters, also delete the Shadow Link even if it has active or paused shadow topics, which become regular, writable topics

flags.name: no-confirm
flags.description: Disable confirmation prompt

flags.name: balancer
flags.description: Group balancer to use when consuming with a consumer group (`range`, `roundrobin`, `sticky`, `cooperative-sticky`).

flags.name: fetch-max-bytes
flags.description: Maximum number of bytes per fetch request per broker.

flags.name: fetch-max-partition-bytes
flags.description: Maximum number of bytes to fetch for a single partition per fetch request.

flags.name: fetch-max-wait
flags.description: Maximum amount of time to wait when fetching from a broker before the broker replies

flags.name: format
flags.description: Output format (see --help for details)

flags.name: group
flags.description: Group to use for consuming (incompatible with -p)

flags.name: meta-only
flags.description: Print all record info except the record value (for -f json)

flags.name: num
flags.description: Quit after consuming this number of records (0 is unbounded)

flags.name: offset
flags.description: Offset to consume from / to (start, end, 47, +2, -3)

flags.name: partitions
flags.description: Comma delimited list of specific partitions to consume

flags.name: pretty-print
flags.description: Pretty print each record over multiple lines (for -f json)

flags.name: print-control-records
flags.description: Opt in to printing control records

flags.name: rack
flags.description: Rack to use for consuming, which opts into follower fetching

flags.name: read-committed
flags.description: Opt in to reading only committed offsets

flags.name: regex
flags.description: Parse topics as regex; consume any topic that matches any expression

flags.name: schema-context
flags.description: Schema Registry context to resolve schemas in. Use topic's redpanda.schema.registry.context if unset. '' or '.' force default context.

flags.name: use-schema-registry
flags.description: Decode record keys and values using schemas from the schema registry. Use `=key` or `=value` to decode only the key or value.

flags.name: dry
flags.description: Validate the topic creation request without actually creating the topic. Useful for testing configuration.

flags.name: if-not-exists
flags.description: Only create the topic if it does not already exist

flags.name: partitions
flags.description: Number of partitions for the topic. The default of `-1` uses the cluster's `default_topic_partitions` property. More partitions enable higher parallelism but increase resource usage.

flags.name: replicas
flags.description: Replication factor (must be odd); -1 defaults to the cluster's default_topic_replications

flags.name: topic-config
flags.description: Topic configuration properties in the format `key=value`. Can be specified multiple times. Example: `--topic-config retention.ms=86400000`.

flags.name: compression
flags.description: Output batch compression type. Valid values: `none`, `gzip`, `snappy`, `lz4`, `zstd`. Defaults to `none`.

flags.name: file
flags.description: The WebAssembly module to deploy

flags.name: from-offset
flags.description: Starting offset for input topic partitions. Use `@T` for a timestamp (Unix milliseconds), `+N` for N records from the start, or `-N` for N records from the end. Only respected on first deploy.

flags.name: input-topic
flags.description: The input topic to apply the transform to

flags.name: name
flags.description: The name of the transform

flags.name: output-topic
flags.description: The output topic to write the transform results to (repeatable)

flags.name: var
flags.description: Specify an environment variable in the form of KEY=VALUE

flags.name: install-deps
flags.description: Install project dependencies automatically after initialization.

flags.name: language
flags.description: The language used to develop the transform

flags.name: name
flags.description: The name of the transform
